correctness.rationale: The cut identity, extremal inequality, equality classification, and diameter-two geodesic reduction are proved in RESULT.md and audited in REVIEW.md.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge; the closest geodesic-subpath, induced-open-triangle, and stress results and residual access risks are documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact all-order maximum and unique extremal graph for a natural broad class, together with a reusable weighted induced-P3 inequality.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
